trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: State the problem and request a refund.
steps.text: हॅलो, माझा एक order आला आहे पण हे earphone defective आहे. मला refund हवा आहे.

steps.purpose: Apologize and ask for the order number.
steps.text: नमस्कार. मला खेद आहे की earphone defective आहे. मी नक्की मदत करेन. कृपया तुमचा order number सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Provide the order number.
steps.text: हो, order number आहे ORD-40003.

steps.purpose: Ask for verification details.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमची माहिती verify करण्यासाठी, कृपया तुमची date of birth सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth.
steps.text: माझी जन्मतारीख आहे बारा August एकोणीसशे शहाऐंशी.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.
Return verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and state intent to check eligibility.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. मी check करतो की या order साठी refund policy काय आहे.

steps.purpose: Check if the item is eligible for return and what the route is.
Return eligibility and route.
Inform the user about the replacement_only policy.
steps.text: तुमचं earphone return साठी eligible आहे, पण हे 'replacement_only' category मध्ये येतं. म्हणजे आम्ही तुम्हाला नवीन earphone देऊ शकतो, पण पैसे परत (refund) मिळणार नाहीत.

steps.purpose: Repeat what the agent said to confirm, with an STT error.
steps.clean_text: म्हणजे मला पैसे परत मिळणार नाहीत? फक्त नवीन earphone मिळणार?
steps.model_visible_text: म्हणजे मला पैसे परत मिळणार नाहीत? फक्त नवीन irfan मिळणार?

steps.purpose: Confirm the policy and offer to schedule a pickup.
steps.text: हो, अगदी बरोबर. या item साठी फक्त replacement दिलं जातं. Refund मिळत नाही. मी तुमच्यासाठी pickup schedule करू का?

steps.purpose: Agree to pickup but ask for plain words explanation of the process.
steps.text: हो, pickup schedule करा. पण ही pickup process कशी असते? मला समजलं नाही.

steps.purpose: Explain the pickup process simply and ask for timing.
steps.text: Pickup process खूप सोपी आहे. एक delivery व्यक्ती तुमच्या घरी येईल आणि तो defective earphone घेऊन जाईल. मी उद्यासाठी हे book करू का?

steps.purpose: Agree to the timing.
steps.text: अच्छा, म्हणजे तो घरी येऊन घेईल. हो, उद्यासाठी book करा.

steps.purpose: Schedule the pickup.
Return pickup schedule details.
Provide pickup details to the user.
steps.text: तुमचा pickup उद्यासाठी book झाला आहे. Courier partner Shadowfax आहे आणि तुमचा pickup ID PU-8832 आहे.

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification on domain terminology.
steps.text: Shadowfax? हे काय आहे? मला plain शब्दात सांगा.

steps.purpose: Explain the courier term in plain language.
steps.text: Shadowfax हे courier कंपनीचं नाव आहे, जसे postman असतात. त्यांचा व्यक्ती उद्या येऊन तुमचा defective earphone घेऊन जाईल.

steps.purpose: Ask about the replacement timeline.
steps.text: ठीक आहे. आणि मग मला नवीन earphone कधी मिळणार?

steps.purpose: State that replacement happens after pickup.
steps.text: आधी उद्या तुमचा earphone pickup होईल, आणि त्यानंतर आम्ही नवीन earphone पाठवू.

steps.purpose: Confirm the sequence of events.
steps.text: म्हणजे आधी pickup होईल, आणि मग नवीन earphone मिळणार. बरोबर ना?

steps.purpose: Validate the user's understanding and offer further help.
steps.text: हो, अगदी बरोबर. आधी pickup, मग replacement. आणि काही विचारायचं आहे का?

steps.purpose: Decline further assistance.
steps.text: नाही, एवढंच विचारायचं होतं. धन्यवाद.

steps.purpose: End the call.
steps.text: Call केल्याबद्दल धन्यवाद. तुमचा दिवस शुभ असो.

ir.terminal_condition: Pickup scheduled and the refund route and timeline stated from the results.
